free_text: Biopsy is recommended because the patient presents with a PI-RADS 4 lesion (14 mm) and a high csPCa predicted probability of 0.8335312. This is strongly supported by a significant PSA velocity of 1.34 ng/mL/yr and a recent PSA rise from 4.4 to 9.3 ng/mL. The evidence converges on sampling due to the high-risk imaging finding combined with dynamic PSA changes, overriding the lack of suspicious DRE findings.
